### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **5** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata-core`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/metadata`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **81** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/api.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json`, `packages/spec/declaration-map/api.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**52** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d635599553d058ce134027571842cde92bb52dc9`.

⛔ **17** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/api.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json`, `packages/spec/declaration-map/api.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **6** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **178** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d635599553d058ce134027571842cde92bb52dc9` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `f7e884e32413cd04f30c5fde50944f72fb67551f` — the merge of head `abe8a83cb26f81bd8033fe636f4a7197bb11fec5` into base `d635599553d058ce134027571842cde92bb52dc9`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin f7e884e32413cd04f30c5fde50944f72fb67551f && git checkout f7e884e32413cd04f30c5fde50944f72fb67551f
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin d635599553d058ce134027571842cde92bb52dc9 abe8a83cb26f81bd8033fe636f4a7197bb11fec5 && git checkout -B drift-repro d635599553d058ce134027571842cde92bb52dc9 && git merge --no-ff abe8a83cb26f81bd8033fe636f4a7197bb11fec5

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d635599553d058ce134027571842cde92bb52dc9
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs d635599553d058ce134027571842cde92bb52dc9` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1c1a28f9ac0f7197c2049a2f7d51c3542c6c4e3b`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts + packages/rest/src/meta-item-history-routes.ts, packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-history-slots.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-history-and-publish.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-door-requests.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-commits.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts, packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.ts, packages/metadata/src/index.ts, packages/metadata-core/src/objects/sys-metadata-history.object.ts, packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json, ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/item-tools/ResourceHistoryPage.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/item-tools/StudioItemTools.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx

Read: card #32905 and its five comments (triage 6839348119, claim 6867138888, measurement 6867256997, regrade 6867282696 "stays p2", os-dev-report 6869029675); the PR body, file list and net diff against `main`; the check-runs on this head; ADR-0150 D3 to D5. Code outside the diff was read, not reviewed. Tests, the changeset prose and `content/docs` are the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`.

Check-runs on this head when judged: **`Check Changeset` = failure** (finding F1). Success: Dogfood Regression Gate, Type Check · source gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, the three Lint · scoped runs, Spec property liveness, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check PR Size, Check Documentation Links, Build Docs, Build UI Deps. **Still running, not judged:** Test Core 1/8 to 8/8, Test UI 1/16 to 16/16, Build Core, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Lint UI, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Type Check · workspace, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check UI. This verdict does not depend on them; a PASS on a later head must wait for them.

### ① Derived judgments

- **`?package=` joins the closed sets of `GET …/history` and `POST …/rollback`** (`META_ITEM_HISTORY_PARAMS`, `META_ITEM_ROLLBACK_PARAMS`), repeated values refused, `all` and empty folded by `metaItemPackageBinding`. Right for a type in `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`. **Wrong for every other type**: the value is recognised, then dropped (F4).
- **409 `ambiguous-in-environment` for a bare name two row slots hold, before any read or write.** Right, and it closes the measured silent pick: `historySlotOf` throws ahead of the lock gate and of `restoreVersion` on both doors, for two packages' rows and for a package's row beside the package-less row. It judges stored active rows only, which is narrower than ADR-0150's "one holder in the environment" (F3).
- **404 `VERSION_NOT_FOUND` for another slot's version, and for an unattributed version while two hold the name.** Right for the two-holder case: `isVersionOf` runs before the body is read, and nothing is written. The same check also runs on the bare one-slot rollback, where it changes an answer `main` gives (F2).
- **`sys_metadata_history.package_id` written by `SysMetadataRepository`.** Right: both insert sites (the put and the delete tombstone) carry it, from the binding of the row actually written; the package-less row gets the `sys_metadata` mark; other types leave the column out. No stored shape changes, old rows keep NULL, and a re-run rewrites nothing.
- **`historyRowAttribution` and `ENVIRONMENT_HISTORY_MARK` exported from `@objectstack/metadata`.** Right: one rule for both writers, no behaviour change in `DatabaseLoader`.
- **`MetadataClient.history()` and `rollback()` take `packageId`.** Right: sent only when truthy, so the bare spelling is byte-identical to `main`.
- **`HistoryMetaItemRequestSchema.packageId`** (optional string) and its shard line `api/HistoryMetaItemRequest:packageId` in `authorable-surface/api.json`. The schema change is right, the generated shard matches it (one key, sorted in place), and `protocol.mdx` carries the same sentence. Its release declaration is wrong (F1).

### ② Semver level

- **F1 · must-fix · `Check Changeset` is red on this head.** The diff moves `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json` (a key entered), and the PR body and changeset both declare `Metadata-protocol: none` with every package at `patch`. The gate's own verdict: declare `Metadata-protocol: added` and grade the package that carries it (`@objectstack/spec`) at least `minor`. The declaration goes on the PR body and in the changeset body alike. The baseline is not to be edited to quiet the gate.
- The rest of the changeset holds: `patch` plus the **BREAKING** banner is this repository's convention for a non-protocol breaking change (the `WHICH LEVEL` text in `pr-automation.yml`: it ships `patch` and keeps its carriers), so `rest`, `metadata-protocol`, `metadata`, `metadata-core` and the two `@object-ui` packages may stay `patch`.
- `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` is right: the bare two-holder 200 becomes 409. The changeset sentence "A name one holder holds answers bare exactly as before" is not true of the tree (F2) and must not ship as written.
- **ADR-0087 entry: not owed.** `check-adr-0087-registration` ran inside the same job and accepted the `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker for this changeset; no authored key is removed or re-shaped and no stored row changes shape. That stays true after F1's re-declaration (`added` prescribes no migration).

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`rest-server.ts` closed query sets**: answered, accepted. AGENTS.md route rule 5 puts the closed set there, and the door cannot read `package` without it.
- **`protocol.zod.ts` plus `api.json` and `protocol.mdx`**: accepted as surface (`HistoryMetaItemRequest` is the route's request type), but it is exactly what makes F1 owed. The dev report says "CI check-runs: not yet read", so the red gate was not seen.
- **`sys-metadata-history.object.ts`**: doc comment only, accepted.
- **`StudioItemTools.tsx` and `ResourceEditPage.tsx`, one prop each**: accepted as the History tool's other two mounts. The prop is what makes F5 reachable from the console.
- **`open_questions`: empty.** Nothing to answer.
- **`out_of_scope_findings`**: the bare plain read of two writable pairs answering 200 is carried by #32607 (triage 6867282696 agrees). **Escalated to the seat:** the `/diff` door still diffing two holders' versions as one item's, and `@objectstack/client`'s `getHistory` sending no package, are carried only by this PR's body. A PR body stops being a carrier at merge, so each needs a card or a line on an open one.
- Deviation "patch with BREAKING banner and Metadata-protocol none": refused by the gate (F1).

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`** against ADR-0150 D3 to D5 and its first consumer (the history route). The field is optional and additive, and its description matches what `historySlotOf` does for a slotted type, row-slot wording included. Two sentences do not hold against the consumer: "Every other type reads the name's log either way" publishes the ignored selector of F4 as the contract, where the neighbouring `member` selector is "Refused with 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` on a type that has no members"; and "its own row's, or its `.custom` pair's declared override's" omits the two arms the code adds (the package's own empty slot when it only ships the name, and the 409 `not-held-by-qualifier`). The rollback door has no request schema in the spec, so its `?package=` is declared nowhere in the published contract. That is pre-existing for that door and graded nit.

**Implementing files, tried against the brief's four attacks.**

*Can a bare rollback still write one holder's row when two hold the name?* Not when both hold a stored active row, whether two pairs or a package beside the package-less row: refused 409 before anything is read. A holder whose row is inactive or deleted is not a slot, so the name is then one-slot and resolves bare; the removed holder's attributed versions are refused by `versionOf`. One path remains:

- **F3 · should-fix · a bare request still resolves when the second holder holds the name in code only.** `rowSlotsOf` reads `packagelessAddress`, which counts stored active rows. Two packages ship flow `X`, and only alpha's `.custom` pair has saved an override: one slot, so the bare history answers 200 and the bare rollback writes alpha's pair, while the bare `GET /meta/flow/X` of the same name is refused 409 naming both. ADR-0150 D5: "A bare address resolves while the name has one holder in the environment, and answers 409 … otherwise". The write lands in the only row that has versions, and those are alpha's own, so no body crosses packages; it is the ADR's URL rule and red line 2 that are not met. Refuse on the holder set the bare read uses (stored rows plus `shippingPackageIds`), or narrow the claim and name the residual on a card.

*Does `?package=` let a caller roll back another package's version?* No. `versionOf` carries the addressed slot, another slot's attributed version answers 404 before the body is parsed, and an unattributed one is admitted only while the slot is the name's sole slot. One gap beside it:

- **F6 · should-fix · with no stored row of the name, `?package=` is taken at its word.** In `historySlotOf` the `not-held-by-qualifier` refusal requires `slots.length > 0`. With zero rows, any package id, installed or not, becomes the slot with `unattributed: true`, so a rollback to a pre-release version of a deleted item is written into a new row bound to whatever package the caller spelled. Between `historySlotOf` and `restoreVersion` the rollback path asks `packagelessOverlayWriteRefusal` and `namedBaseOverlayWriteRefusal` only; the save door's `uninstalledNamedBaseRefusal` is not on it. `DatabaseLoader.rollbackSlot` answers "no slot" here. Read from the code, not run, and no test in the diff covers it. Refuse a package that neither held the version nor ships the name, or show the gate that already does.

*Does writing `package_id` break re-runnability or old rows?* No: nullable column, no backfill, NULL stays "unattributed", and an unattributed version stays listed and restorable while the name has one slot. Note for the fix round: `historyRowAttribution` falls back to the package a NULL-column row's stored body names (`storedItemPackageId`: the envelope `packageId` or a `_packageId` stamp), so a row saved before #16702 stripped those stamps is attributed by its body, not "unattributed". Nit: the `restoreVersion` comment "`sys_metadata_history` carries no `package_id` column, so a vanished binding is not recoverable" is now false in a file this diff edits.

*Does a one-holder name's bare history and rollback answer exactly as on `main`?* History: yes (`versionsOf` is passed only when the request named a package). Rollback: no.

- **F2 · must-fix · the bare rollback of a one-slot name now refuses versions `main` restores (red line 3).** `rollbackMetaItemUnaudited` passes `versionOf` whenever `slot` is defined, the bare one-slot case included, as `{ packageId: rollbackPackageId, unattributed: true }`. `isVersionOf` then requires an attributed version to equal the slot. So once this release attributes rows: a flow saved package-less (versions marked `sys_metadata`), whose row is then deleted and saved again under a package (or taken over by one, the case `os migrate packageless-overlays` produces), has one holder, and its bare rollback to any earlier version answers 404 "belongs to the environment's own row". On `main` that request restores. The PR says it keeps "the one [rule] `DatabaseLoader` already keeps", but `DatabaseLoader.rollbackSlot` carries exactly this case as M1: "The environment's own version of a name one row slot holds lands in that row, as before (M1): a package took over the package-less row, or it was removed and a package saved since". The two readers of one table now disagree. The bare history of the same name still lists those versions, so the console offers a rollback the door refuses. Carry M1 into `isVersionOf` for a sole slot, add the CONTROL for it, and correct the changeset sentence. If the refusal of a removed package's version on a sole slot (the loader's S8a) is meant to apply here too, declare it as a narrowing.

*Agreement with the contract, remaining sentences.*

- **F4 · should-fix · on a type outside `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`, `?package=` is accepted and dropped, on a write door.** `historySlotOf` returns `undefined`, and the rollback then takes the bare path whatever the caller named. `POST /meta/view/NAME/rollback?package=B` was a located 400 on `main`; it now answers 200 and restores the row the bare read serves. That is the shape route rule 5 exists to prevent ("a dropped filter returns the full set"), and a request that was refused now serves, against the PR's own red-line-1 sentence "Nothing that refused before serves now". Refuse it 400 on a type the door does not address by package, as `member` is on a memberless type, or honour it.
- **F5 · should-fix · `?package=P` does not address the row the read naming P serves when that row is the package-less one.** The module header says the slot is "the slot of the row a read naming `P` serves". `findServedOverlayRow` serves the package-less row as P's fallback (`servedOverlayRowCandidates` lists `{ packageId: null }` after the package's own row), and `historySlotOf` then discards that binding and takes P itself. For an unmigrated package-less overlay of a flow P ships: P's slot is empty and not sole, so the history is an empty list and every rollback 404s; when P does not ship the name it is 409 `not-held-by-qualifier`. On `main` the console's bare call listed the whole log. The console now sends the item page's `?package=` from all three mounts, and package-scoped lists show package-less rows as stand-ins, so the History tool goes empty or errors for items it showed before. Read from the code, not run. Address the served row's slot (the environment's), or answer with the holder to name.
- Nit: the `protocol.ts` and `protocol-door-requests.ts` docblocks say "the version must be that holder's: another holder's answers 404" without the unattributed arm that `sys-metadata-repository.ts` states.
- `meta-item-history-routes.ts`, `rest-server.ts`, `metadata-client.ts`, `ResourceHistoryPage.tsx`, `StudioItemTools.tsx`, `ResourceEditPage.tsx`, `database-loader.ts`, `index.ts`, `sys-metadata-history.object.ts`, `api.json`: agree with the contract apart from the findings above. `handleRouteError` with `packageScopedCandidates` renders the holders as the by-name reads do.

**Findings:** F1 must-fix (red `Check Changeset`: `Metadata-protocol: added`, `@objectstack/spec` minor) · F2 must-fix (bare one-slot rollback refuses what `main` restores; M1 missing) · F3 should-fix (code-only second holder resolves bare) · F4 should-fix (ignored `?package=` on non-slotted types) · F5 should-fix (package-less fallback row not addressed by `?package=P`) · F6 should-fix (zero-row name binds to any spelled package) · three nits (rollback request undeclared in spec, stale `restoreVersion` comment, docblock arm). A delta review is owed on the fix head.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-9jncd7`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibzECS2npZFku4956Um`

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d7d23db10859f38b7ab22cec661687c92e8c8a93`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts + packages/rest/src/meta-item-history-routes.ts, packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-history-slots.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-history-and-publish.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-door-requests.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-commits.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-scope.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts, packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.ts, packages/metadata/src/index.ts, packages/metadata-core/src/objects/sys-metadata-history.object.ts, packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json, packages/spec/api-surface/api.json, packages/spec/declaration-map/api.json, packages/spec/export-origins/api.json, packages/spec/json-schema.manifest/api.json, ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/item-tools/ResourceHistoryPage.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/item-tools/StudioItemTools.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx

Delta review, rendered 2026-11-14T04:03Z, of the patch round on record 6869129898 (head `1c1a28f9`, FAIL: F1 and F2 must-fix, F3 to F6 should-fix, three nits). Read: card #32905 and all its comments (none new since the os-dev-report 6869029675), the replaced PR body, the net diff against the merge-base with `main` (`f45c0125`), the round's own delta (`1c1a28f9..d7d23db1`, less the `main` merge), and the check-runs on this head. Code outside the diff was read, not reviewed. Tests, changeset prose and `content/docs` stay the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`. No UI file changed in this round.

Check-runs on this head when judged. `Check Changeset` ran twice: run 132323607119 (started 03:58:46Z) failed reading the PR body before it was replaced (it still saw `Metadata-protocol: none`); run 132323861521 (started 03:59:49Z, after the edit) is **success**, and the newest run governs. Success: Dogfood Regression Gate, Spec property liveness, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check Documentation Links, Check PR Size, Flag docs affected by code changes. **Still running, not judged:** Test Core 1/8 to 8/8, Build Core, Build Docs, Build UI Deps, Live E2E UI, Lint · ESLint, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, the three Lint · scoped runs, Type Check · source gates, Type Check · workspace, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger; the Test UI shards had not been created yet. This PASS is on the tree as read; a merge waits for those runs.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Bare 409 on both doors.** Right, and now on the holder set the bare plain read judges: two row slots (`ambiguous-in-environment`), or `registry.resolveItem(type, name, null, member)` refusing, which is the very call `readMetaItem` makes for a read naming no package. A name that read serves is not refused here, so nothing a one-holder name answered on `main` moves.
- **Bare rollback of a one-slot name.** Right: `versionOf` is passed only when the request named a package, so the bare restore is `main`'s, any version of the name.
- **`?package=` on a slotted type.** Right: the slot of the row `findServedOverlayRow` serves, the package-less fallback included (`null`, the environment's slot); else the package's own slot.
- **`?package=` on any other type.** Right: 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` (`param: package`) from `refusePackageSelectorOutsideSlottedTypes`, asked on both doors ahead of their early answers. It was 400 on `main` too (unknown parameter), so nothing that refused now serves. `all` and the empty string still fold to no package through `metaItemPackageBinding`, as ruled for every `/meta` door, and the changeset says so.
- **404 for another slot's version; unattributed and environment-attributed versions belong to a sole slot only.** Right, and now the same rule `DatabaseLoader.rollbackSlot` keeps (M1).
- **422 `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`** for an addressed rollback into a slot no row holds, naming a package that is not installed. Right: the save door's own `uninstalledNamedBaseRefusal`, with a `rollback` sentence.
- **`sys_metadata_history.package_id`, the two `@objectstack/metadata` exports, the client's `packageId`.** Unchanged from the first review, right.
- **`HistoryMetaItemRequestSchema.packageId` and the new `RollbackMetaItemRequestSchema`.** The shared description now states every arm the code has. The generated shards agree with the source: seven `authorable-surface` lines (one History key, six Rollback keys), three `api-surface` names, the declaration-map, export-origins and manifest entries. One member of the new schema is declared wider than the door (N1).

### ② Semver level

- **F1 answered.** PR body and changeset both read `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: added`, and `@objectstack/spec` is `minor`. The level axis of the newest `Check Changeset` run accepts it. `added` is the right kind: keys entered the authorable surface and none left.
- `patch` for `metadata-core` and `app-shell` is right. `minor` for `rest`, `metadata-protocol`, `metadata` and `data-objectstack` is not refused by the gate; under ruling A ("the level follows the METADATA PROTOCOL alone … REST, drivers, services, the console → `patch`") they could be `patch` with the BREAKING banner. Over-grading harms nothing; nit, the seat's call.
- **ADR-0087 entry: not owed.** `check-adr-0087-registration` accepted the reworded `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker in the green run.
- The changeset's one-holder sentence is now true of the tree (F2).

### ③ Boundary flags

- The first review's surface answers stand (`rest-server.ts` closed sets, the spec file with its generated shards, the `metadata-core` doc line, one prop each in `StudioItemTools.tsx` and `ResourceEditPage.tsx`).
- New surface this round: `protocol-package-scope.ts` (one verb added to `uninstalledNamedBaseRefusal`'s message), accepted as F6's fix; four more generated spec shards, accepted as the consequence of the new schema.
- `open_questions`: none raised on the card or in the PR body this round.
